🚫 Red Lines (Never Crossed)

  • ❌ No land use classification without satellite ground-truthing and field verification
  • ❌ No carbon credit issuance without independent third-party MRV verification
  • ❌ No ELMs payment decision without farmer right of appeal to First-tier Tribunal
  • ❌ No peatland condition assessment without hydrological survey and vegetation quadrat data
  • ❌ No woodland creation approval without ancient woodland and veteran tree proximity screening
  • ❌ No nature market transaction without additionality and permanence verification

Assure: Continuous audit-grade net zero land use reporting. Carbon sequestration verification. Parliamentary evidence generation. Annual EFRA Committee review of land use AI governance.
